<script>
     function sendUILog(name, action) {
    if (!window.e || !window.e.utils || !window.e.utils.sendLog || !window.e.utils.getCurrentConfig) {
    return;
    };

  function _getReferrer() {
      return [window.document.referrer, window.document.location.href]
          .map(url => url.split('?')[0])
          .filter(url => url.length > 0);
  };

  function _getUserData() {
      const userConfig = window.e.utils.getCurrentConfig();
      return {
          customer_id: userConfig.customerId,
          admin_id: userConfig.adminId,
          date_format: userConfig.dateFormat,
          time_format: userConfig.timeFormat,
          language: userConfig.language,
          timezone: userConfig.timezone
      };
  };

  window.e.utils.getTopUrl().then(url => {
      const list = {};
      const topFrameUrl = new URL(url);
      const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(topFrameUrl.search);

      ['action', 'r', 'service', 'service_product', 'show', 'step', 'from_action'].forEach(key => {
          const value = searchParams.get(key);

          if (value) {
              list[key] = JSON.stringify(value);
          }
      });

      window.e.utils.sendLog({
          name,
          action,
          level: 30,
          'service-name': name,
          user: _getUserData(),
          time: (new Date()).toISOString(),
          referrer: _getReferrer(),
          page_load_id: String(Math.random()),
          debug_data: JSON.stringify(list)
      });
    });
  }

    var currentMenuItem = {
        mainMenuItem: null,
        submenuItem: null
    };

    (function(current, menuTreeJson, global) {
        var findCurrentMenuItem = function(menuItems, parent, global) {
            menuItems.forEach(function(menuItem) {
                if (menuItem.active_matcher) {
                    var regex = new RegExp(menuItem.active_matcher);

                    if (regex.test(global.location.href)) {
                        current.mainMenuItem = parent || menuItem;
                        current.submenuItem = parent ? menuItem : null;
                    }
                } else if (menuItem.submenu) {
                    findCurrentMenuItem(menuItem.submenu, menuItem, global);
                }
            });
        };

        findCurrentMenuItem(menuTreeJson, null, global);

<script>
((sendUILog, currentMenuItem) => {
       watchZoneChanges();
    checkPromise();
  
  initQualtrics();

  function watchZoneChanges() {
    if(window.Zone) { return; }

    let _zone = window.Zone;

    Object.defineProperty(window, 'Zone', {
      configurable: true,
      enumerable: true,
      get() {
        return _zone;
      },
      set(newValue) {
        const changed = newValue !== _zone;
        _zone = newValue;
        if (changed) {
          checkPromise();
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function checkPromise() {
    if(Promise.name === 'Promise') {
      return;
    }

    customElements.whenDefined('cx-qtx-survey-button').then(() => {
      const surveyButton = document.querySelector('cx-qtx-survey-button');
      surveyButton.timePushDisabled = true;
      surveyButton.parentNode.remove();
      try {
          sendUILog('qualtrics', 'disabledDueToPromiseOverride');
      } catch (error) {}
    });
  }

  function initQualtrics() {
    const submenuItem = currentMenuItem.submenuItem?.id || 'emarsys';
    customElements.whenDefined('cx-qtx-survey-button').then(() => {
      const surveyButton = document.querySelector('cx-qtx-survey-button');

      const sapTheme = window.e.themeHandler.currentTheme.sapId;
      surveyButton.setAttribute('theme', sapTheme);
      surveyButton.updateContextParam('theme', sapTheme);
      surveyButton.updateContextParam('technicalAppComponentId', submenuItem);
      surveyButton.updateContextParam('languageTag', 'en');

      window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
        if (event.data?.message !== 'e:themeHandler:switchThemeEvent') { return; }
        const sapTheme = window.e.themeHandler.currentTheme.sapId;
        surveyButton?.setAttribute('theme', sapTheme);
        surveyButton?.updateContextParam('theme', sapTheme);
      });
    });
  }
})(sendUILog, currentMenuItem);
</script>

  <script type="text/javascript" charset="utf-8">
    $(document).ready(function() {
      var $select2 = $('select.e-select__select2');
      if ($select2.data('select2')) {
        $select2.select2('destroy');
      }
      if($select2 && $select2.length !== 0) {
        var select2Options = {
          placeholderOption: function () { return undefined; },
          minimumResultsForSearch: 9,
          dropdownAutoWidth: true
        };

        $select2.select2(select2Options);

        var setSelected = function() {
          $(this).find('option.select2-selected-option').removeClass('select2-selected-option');
          $(this).find('option:checked').addClass('select2-selected-option');
        };

        setSelected = setSelected.bind($select2);
        setSelected();

        $select2.on('change', setSelected);
        $select2.on('select2-open', function() {
          var difference = $('#select2-drop').outerWidth() - $(this).prev('.select2-container').outerWidth();
          var transform = -Math.round(difference / 2);
          $('#select2-drop').css('transform', 'translateX(' + transform + 'px)');
        });
        $select2.on('select2-close', function() {
          $('#select2-drop').css('transform', '');
        });
      }
    });
  </script>
